FILED s543j (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22) from #2742's probe table (member 2).  PRE-EXISTING (main b58114ca the same).

REPRODUCER (scratch/s543j/probes/file in the s543j worktree (agent-abcd8b98eb856dbee)/t5331.pl):
    our %h = (k => 1); our @a = (1);
    sub f { local $h{k} } sub g { local $h{k}; $h{k} } sub e { local $a[0]; $a[0] }
    my @l = f(); my @m = g(); my @n = e(); print scalar(@l), scalar(@m), scalar(@n), "\n";
  perl: 111      PCL: 000

MECHANISM (read): %p-lhe-save installs `(make-p-box nil)` (and the array twin the same); p-gethash of it returns the raw NIL, and a sub's tail value NIL is the EMPTY list in list context (an absent key reads *p-undef* = one element: `sub f { $h{k} }` on a missing key is right).  `my @x = ($h{k})` is right (the vector builds one element).  The fix is the runtime's: the fresh element holds perl's undef value (*p-undef*), or the element read turns a NIL box value into *p-undef* -- measure which callers read the NIL.  s543j's #2742 value for a bare `local $h{k}` tail was written and REVERTED (it cannot help while the element reads NIL).

=== DONE (s543l) ===
Measured (scratch/s543l/probes/m2, 15 shapes): the readers that saw the raw NIL were the ones that FLATTEN -- a sub's
list return (`sub f { local $h{k} }`, `local $h{k}; $h{k}`, `return $h{k}`), `delete`'s list (`my @r = delete $h{k}`),
a chained / lexical element; exists / defined / keys / values / each / a slice read / scalar(%h) / the restore / a
tied hash were right.  Also: `local $a[N]` past the end did not extend the array (perl: N+1 long, element N exists).
THE CHOICE: the STORE -- %p-lhe-save installs (make-p-box *p-undef*), and the array twins share %p-local-array-fresh,
which also extends a short array (the restore already trimmed it back).  No element read changed (the read-side NIL ->
undef turn would have added a test to every element read).  #2742's reverted element value re-applied: a bare `local
ELEM` / `local SLICE` ending a valued block is the fresh element(s) by context (_local_plan_elem's value; a cast BLOCK
the plan leaves unbound gets none -- `local ${ f() }{k}` would evaluate f twice).  Probes m2: base 6 -> tree 15 on
STDOUT (c12's stderr 'Use of uninitialized value in join' without warnings = #2940, pre-existing).  Guard
local-stmt-01.t row 18.  Cost: see the session-log Bars (the bench leg: l1 / l2 / l3 / l4).
